game_title: Break Out – Moss Door Chamber Race
game_concept: A racing platformer set in Shadow Cave – Moss Door Chamber, a mossy sealed door: the shadow ranger must handle skeleton miners while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Break Out: Use break to leave a loop the moment a dangerous foe is spotted.
theme: Shadow Cave – Moss Door Chamber: a mossy sealed door
core_gameplay_loop: In Moss Door Chamber, repeat each round: Use break to leave a loop the moment a dangerous foe is spotted. Each round the rival advances, and solving the step moves the shadow ranger ahead. Then check the alert value and advance.
player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the supply cache by solving code steps involving alert that move the shadow ranger forward.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.8).
lose_condition: The rival reaches the supply cache first, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 4 – Control Flow: While Loops | Level 7 (applied tier): Break Out
assets_style: dark pixel-art cavern: torchlit stone, mossy rock, deep shadows, glowing crystals; flat Kenney-style sprites; echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Break Out' (Week 4 slot 10), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Moss Door Chamber'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Shadow Cave

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how alert changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against skeleton miners in Moss Door Chamber.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.8).
